source: yctimlin/mcp_excalidraw seven-point screenshot checklist (upstream claim, not reproduced here) plus campaign STEM extensions

checks.description: Is all label text fully visible?
Do any shapes share the same space?
Do arrows cut through unrelated elements?
Do arrow labels overlap shapes at arrow midpoints?
Font size at least 16 for body, 20 for titles
Background-zone labels must not be centered over children
Extension: each label refers to the correct shape or arrow
Extension: mathematical and chemical symbols rendered correctly
STEM: single, double and triple bonds annotated correctly
STEM: vector and force arrow direction and sense correct
